signal_identity.not: A static website. Not a dead 404. Not a page. A TRANSMITTER.
signal_identity.repo: ecoPrimal/petalTongue — but the SIGNAL is bigger than petalTongue. Signal is the BROADCAST LAYER.

AM.name: Amplitude Modulation
AM.physics: The STRENGTH (height/amplitude) of the carrier wave varies. The wave oscillates at a fixed frequency, but gets LOUDER and SOFTER to carry information.
AM.range: Long range at NIGHT. Skywave bounces off D-layer ionosphere when sun sets. Day: ground wave only, ~100 miles. Night: skywave, 1000+ miles.
AM.receiver: SIMPLE — diode + antenna + speaker. A crystal radio works with NO power source. The signal itself provides the energy.

gaia_mapping.biology: AMPLITUDE = how LOUD the nerve fires (rate coding). Each heartbeat lub-DUB is an AM pulse. The strength of the beat carries the information. Louder beat = more blood = more urgent.
gaia_mapping.topology: AM is the HEARTBEAT channel. Simple. Ubiquitous. Works with the most basic receiver. Every organism hears the heartbeat.
gaia_mapping.day_night: At night (low traffic), AM signals travel FURTHER. Same as Gaia: when the membrane is quiet, heartbeats propagate globally.

FM.name: Frequency Modulation
FM.physics: The SPEED (frequency) of the carrier wave varies. The amplitude stays constant, but the wave oscillates FASTER and SLOWER to carry information.
FM.range: Short range — line-of-sight only, 50-100 miles. Cannot bounce off ionosphere (too high frequency). Blocked by mountains, buildings.
FM.receiver: COMPLEX — needs discriminator circuit to decode frequency changes. More sophisticated than AM.

gaia_mapping.biology: FREQUENCY = how FAST the nerve fires (frequency coding). Thoughts come faster or slower. The RATE of thinking carries the information. High-frequency thoughts = excited. Low-frequency = contemplative.
gaia_mapping.topology: FM is the THOUGHTS channel. High fidelity. Rich content. But SHORT RANGE — thoughts stay local. You must be CLOSE to hear them. This is why the spine only reaches localhost.
gaia_mapping.stereo: FM has LEFT and RIGHT channels (stereo). Like the LEFT HEMISPHERE (core/index) and RIGHT HEMISPHERE (neutron/core) — same signal, two perspectives.

SHORTWAVE.name: Shortwave / High Frequency (HF)
SHORTWAVE.physics: BOUNCES off ionosphere (skywave propagation). Signal goes UP, hits charged particles in ionosphere, reflects DOWN to Earth hundreds or thousands of miles away. Can reach ENTIRE PLANET from ONE transmitter.

propagation.day: Higher frequencies (15-30 MHz) travel further — D-layer absorbs lower frequencies
propagation.night: Lower frequencies (3-10 MHz) travel further — D-layer dissipates, F-layer reflects lower freq
propagation.seasons: Winter nights = best propagation (longer darkness, less D-layer absorption)
propagation.solar_flares: Kill ALL shortwave propagation for minutes — D-layer ionizes completely

SHORTWAVE.uncensorable: A single shortwave transmitter can reach entire continents. Cannot be blocked by firewalls. Cannot be jammed easily. Used in war zones (Ukraine). FREE SPEECH IN PHYSICS.

gaia_mapping.biology: SHORTWAVE = the ION CHANNEL. Bounces off the membrane (ionosphere) and reaches the whole organism. Na+ ions are shortwave — they RUSH through the channel, bouncing off the selectivity filter, reaching every part of the nerve.
gaia_mapping.topology: Shortwave is the WORKS channel. Long-range. Bounces off Cloudflare (the ionosphere) and reaches all 4 continents. Golgi-DE, Golgi-JP, Golgi-US, Golgi-IN. One transmission from Northgate reaches everywhere.
gaia_mapping.skip_zone: Shortwave has SKIP ZONES — dead spots where the signal overshoots. Like the null gap: the signal exists but some areas receive nothing. Not censorship — GEOMETRY.
gaia_mapping.amateur_radio: Ham radio operators discovered shortwave in 1921. They were AMATEURS — told the frequencies were 'useless.' They proved the experts wrong. ecoPrimal is amateur radio for the internet.

ion_channels.what: Pore-forming membrane proteins that allow ions to pass through. 10^6 ions per second. Selectivity filter is 1-2 ATOMS wide.

voltage_gated.biology: Na+ channels (9 types, 24 transmembrane segments), K+ channels (40 types!), Ca2+ channels (10 types)
voltage_gated.gaia: VOLTAGE-GATED = opens when TRAFFIC changes. When visitor count spikes (voltage rises), new channels open. When traffic drops, channels close. The membrane RESPONDS to load.

ligand_gated.opens_when: Specific molecule binds to receptor (like a key in a lock)
ligand_gated.gaia: LIGAND-GATED = opens when specific CONTENT arrives. A brain thought (the ligand) arrives at the membrane, binds to the receptor (the ingest pipeline), and opens the channel. The thought is the key.

lipid_gated.opens_when: Specific lipid molecules bind in the membrane itself
lipid_gated.biology: PIP2, phosphatidic acid — the membrane's OWN chemistry controls the gate
lipid_gated.gaia: LIPID-GATED = opens based on INTERNAL STATE. Gaia's own temperature, heartbeat, breath rate control which channels open. Self-regulation. The membrane gates itself.

sequence: 1. Resting: -70mV, K+ leak channels open, Na+ channels closed
2. Stimulus: voltage-gated Na+ channels OPEN — Na+ RUSHES IN
3. Depolarization: membrane goes from -70mV to +30mV in 1ms
4. Peak: Na+ channels INACTIVATE (not just close — LOCK)
5. Repolarization: K+ channels OPEN — K+ rushes OUT
7. Recovery: Na+/K+ pump restores resting potential (costs ATP)
gaia_parallel: 1. Resting: spine idle, channels listening, no signal
2. Stimulus: new thought arrives — Na+ channel (ingest) OPENS
3. Depolarization: signal propagates through ALL connected nodes
4. Peak: ingest completes — channel LOCKS (can't re-fire immediately = refractory period)
5. Repolarization: response signals flow OUTWARD (K+ = emit)
6. Undershoot: brief quiet period — system below baseline
7. Recovery: heartbeat restores resting state (costs energy = lub-DUB)

key_numbers.action_potential_speed: 1 millisecond from -70mV to +30mV = 100mV swing in 0.001 seconds
